title: even BETTER Cobblemon
description: An all-round improved Cobblemon, with all the Pokémon related addons and more, that no other modpack fully brings.
body: The perfect modpack for Cobblemon, with more than 50 mods , including many useful add-ons to improve gameplay, performance, and quality of life, made for Fabric and version 1.21.1 of Minecraft. The goal is to create a complete Pokémon-style experience in Minecraft while keeping the game stable and fun to play with friends. This modpack is perfect for servers but it also works well in singleplayer. If you want a better and cooler Cobblemon experience, without changing it's core vibe, this modpack is for you.
